notes.title: Update 3, another update released today!
Update 3, another update released today!
Update 2, The Cleansing - versus
notes.content:
This week we have brought you another update of The Cleansing - versus. The work to improve the controls have continued and more visual feedbacks have been added. 

Improvements 
 
    It's now possible to set game speed in the lobby before you start a game (currently in experimental stage)
Updated cosmetic things in the game lobby UI and the Winner UI screen
    Made your team's units more visible when behind obstacles, such as house and trees
    Increased view range of all classes to 3000 units at start
    Increased cameras zoom out distance
Units can now walk up the stairs on all monuments which can be found in the victory points
Texture size optimizations
Minimap now supports queue goto waypoints
Improved select unit mechanism
Buildings can now be added to control groups
 

Balance

Characters

Class Highborn now walks slower
Class Highborn has now less life (new value 70 hp)

Weapons start hit rate adjustments

Two handed swords increased - Highborns
Shotgun decreased - Highborns
Shotgun decreased - Highborns
Bow increased - Ranger
Assault rifle increased - Recruit
Big  Turret  increased
 
Weapon damage adjusted

Shotguns
Guns
 
Turret
Increased vision for Turret units when mounted

Bugs

Fixed an issue when a goto command on the minimap didn't hit a navigational area which resulted in a character not moving at all
Large amounts of collision & navigation fixes on maps


That's all for this time, until next update.
//Dev team

notes.title: Update 1, The Cleansing
notes.content:
Hi all, a new update is live. What have we been doing since last week?



Bugs and development
 A lot of effort has been put into stability of the matchmaking and lobby functionality. The work will continue
 Fixed lobby kick bug that messed up the lobby in general
 Made all resolutions supported by your graphic card avaialble to set in fullscreen mode (window mode will also be added later on)
 Fixed bug for graphical settings
 The winners didn't show when the "Game Over" dialog showed in the end of the game 

Balance
 Recruit passive skill "Pin down" only work with Assault Rifle now

Servers
 Asia and US has been disabled for now, they will be started when we see a demand for it



//Dev team

notes.title: Welcome to The Cleansing world
notes.content:
Hi all,
dev team here. We're excited to finally have reached a state in production where we think it's time to go into an Early access phase. Our ambition is to make weekly updates for the game, and we really need your opinions and feedback to make The Cleansing great!

Our current working priorities are the ones listed below:

  Get the matchmaking run flawless
  Improvements on UI related to ranking/matchmaking/profile
  AI improvements
  Game performance
  Gathering feedback for hero classes and path 
  Game balance
  Other bugs


Post any feedback you think would make the game better and more fun. Don't be a stranger!

//Dev team
